title: Boxing in his youth
summary: He was an amateur boxer at about 125 pounds around age 21, never a professional.

blocks.x: Well, there's one other question, sort of a personal question. Some people have told about how you used to be a boxer and all. Did you really do any fighting professionally? No, Bill, no.

I never was no professional fighter there. That got out somehow or another. But I was a boxer, Bill. I was no fighter. I used to go around and box around the north side. That time, Lopo St. Roman. That time when Tico and them guys was coming up like that, you know? Before getting in the ring and fighting for real money. I never was that. I never could make that.
How heavy were you in those days?
Oh, Bill, I was about 125 pounds. That's pretty light. Yeah. But when was that? What period of your life?
How old were you? Oh, Bill.
I was about 21 years old in the day.
